APPROVED as to form only:
By David Hopkinson at 8:38 am, Feb 03 2026
RESOLUTION NO. /5I4
ENTITLED:"A RESOLUTION EXPRESSING THE SUPPORT OF THE GOVERNING
BODY FOR THE INCLUSION OF LARAMIE COUNTY PROPERTY ID
DISTRICT."
WHEREAS, on July 9,1984, the Governing Body approved Ordinance No.2804 creating
the Downtown Development Authority (herein referred to as“Authority") and Downtown
Development District(herein referred toas"District");
WHEREAS, Dhanminder Singh and Surekha Kumari are the owners of real property
situated at 2100 Snyder Avenue, Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (herein referred to as
"Property") comprising of point twenty-five acres(.25) more particularly described as:
CHEYENNE: East 16 feet of Lot 7 and all of Lot 8, Block 224; all in the Original City of
Cheyenne.
WHEREAS, in accordance with Wyoming Statute S 15-9-223, subsequent to the
organization of an Authority, additional property may be included in the development area
provided theowner or owners in fee of each parcel of land adjacent to the existing District petition
the Downtown Development Authority Board (herein referred to as*Board")to be included in
the District;
WHEREAS, landowners of the Property have petitioned to be within the District and the
property is contiguous with the District;
WHEREAS, on January 15,2026 the Board of the Authority approved the petition for
inclusion;
WHEREAS, it is the desire of the Governing Body to include this land in the District to
increase opportunity for property owners adjacent to the Property;
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Governing Bodyof the City of
Cheyenne supports the inclusion of the Property and adjacent rights-of-way in the District.
Patrick Collins, Mayor
(SEAL)
ATTEST:
Kylie Soden, City Clerk
